subject: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation, retention granularity & capacity uplift
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harper <tharper@bluebay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Dec 2029 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation, retention granularity & capacity uplift

Hi Tom —

As BlueBay's renewal window approaches (contract RW-3245), I wanted to align on the SOC 2 re-attestation scope and a few term items we discussed on the last call:

- Retention window: you're asking about expanding the audit log retention from 90 days to 365 days for a subset of sensitive routes.
- Evidence handoff cadence: preferred weekly bulk exports vs. parallel streaming?
- Capacity uplift: proposed committed vGPU hours for Q1 to cover your seasonal peak.

I've attached an evidence matrix that maps the typical artifacts BlueBay needs for re-attestation and two retention options (90d vs 365d) with the operational implications. If you can confirm which retention granularity you want for which routes (auth, admin, data-export), we'll build the amended SOW and an associated pricing line for the uplift.

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), Retention-compare-90vs365.pdf (summary)

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm retention per route by EOD Friday (2029-12-06).
2) We send an updated contract amendment (term + retention + seat/capacity uplift).
3) DocuSign + procurement -> kickoff the evidence transfer sprint.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min sync if useful.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Lead, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

--
Attachment stubs: SOC2-evidence-matrix.xlsx (12 KB), Retention-compare-90vs365.pdf (350 KB)
From: Tom Harper <tharper@bluebay.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@bluebay.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Dec 2029 10:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation, retention granularity & capacity uplift

Thanks Ava —

Appreciate the clear matrix. Quick answers from our side:
- Retention: we want 365-day retention for auth and admin audit logs; data-export routes can remain at 90 days for now.
- Evidence handoff: weekly bulk exports to our SFTP are preferred for the initial re-attestation window (Dec–Feb), then we can evaluate streaming for ongoing monitoring.
- Capacity: we'll need +20% committed capacity for peak trading days in January; exact numbers TBD but please include the uplift pricing.

I'll loop procurement (Sara) — Sara, can you confirm if a single contract amendment and PO is easiest for you, or do you need a separate SOW for the retention change?

Ava / Priya —

Noted. I'm pulling together the pricing options:
- Retention amendment: 90d -> 365d for auth/admin routes (approx incremental storage + ingestion costs). Draft line item in proposal-capacity-uplift-v2.pdf.
- Capacity uplift: +20% committed vGPU hours -> I'll model two cadence options: one-time seasonal top-up vs monthly committed increase.

If BlueBay wants the longer retention only for a route subset, we can create a tiered retention pricing row (per-route selector). That keeps the base contract smaller and gives a clear uplift path.

Action items for Priya: can you prepare a clean amendment template (term + retention language + pricing rows) so we can push to DocuSign once Tom confirms procurement preference? Also include a 60-day rollback clause for the retention change (so we don't carry 365d for routes if they revert).

Thanks,
Marcus

marcus.lin@redwood.com

Thanks all — quick summary and commitments: 

1) BlueBay confirms 365d for auth/admin, 90d for data-export. (Tom)
2) Procurement accepts single amendment path; PO lead is Sara. (Sara)
3) Marcus to finalize pricing rows for: retention amendment (per-route), capacity uplift (+20% seasonal vs monthly commit variants). Deliverable: updated amendment PDF + pricing by 2029-12-11 EOD. (Marcus)
4) Priya to draft amendment language including a 60-day rollback clause and standard SOC 2 evidence delivery SLA. (Priya)
5) Once amendment is approved, we'll send DocuSign link (DocuSign: 0a9f-RW-3245) and evidence export schedule (weekly SFTP).

Attachments sent to procurement: proposal-capacity-uplift-v2.pdf, SOC2-evidence-matrix.xlsx, Retention-compare-90vs365.pdf

If nobody objects, I'll kick off the amendment draft now and aim to have the DocuSign ready for Sara's PO by Dec 12 so BlueBay can hit the Dec 18 renewal board.
